title: Oath and Sigil Revisited
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Xanthe Oyelaran, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
